password_hashing.mechanism: PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 with 16-byte random salt and 100,000 iterations

jwt_lifecycle.mechanism: PyJWT HS256 with configurable expiry and claim verification

expired_jwt_rejection.evidence: Tokens with past expiration timestamp rejected by decode_access_token (returns None, triggers HTTP 401)

tampered_jwt_rejection.evidence: Tokens with invalid HMAC signatures rejected by decode_access_token

role_based_access_control_rbac.evidence: test_role_authorization_rbac_enforcement passed; restricted actions reject unauthorized roles with HTTP 403 Forbidden

path_traversal_protection.evidence: test_path_traversal_and_malformed_filename_protection passed; filenames with ../, ..\, or absolute paths rejected with HTTP 400

filename_sanitization.evidence: IngestionService strips directory traversal components and safely derives storage filenames via SHA-256 digest

unsupported_mime_type_validation.evidence: test_unsupported_mime_type_protection passed; non-image MIME types rejected with HTTP 400

oversized_upload_rejection.evidence: test_oversized_upload_rejection passed; uploads exceeding MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE_BYTES rejected with HTTP 400

credential_leakage_prevention.evidence: test_closure_provenance_and_audit_full_spectrum passed; persistent audit logs and API responses do not expose passwords, secret keys, or DB credentials
